grid.name: northshore
grid.units: battle-map pixels (c29-b34), 2.6 km each, y down
grid.cell: x = x0 + i·dx, y = y0 + j·dy; row-major from j = 0

height_m.encoding: base64 Int16, little-endian, meters above sea level; below 0 is sea

water.rule: sea where height_m < 0; lakes where the lakes mask is 1
